description_en: Queries the details of all ApsaraDB RDS regions and zones, including decommissioned regions. Use with caution
description_zh: 该接口用于查询所有RDS地域和可用区详情（包含已裁撤地域，请谨慎使用）
name: DescribeRegions

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned LocalName parameter. Valid values:
zh-CN: Chinese
en-US: English

Default value: en-US
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回的LocalName参数的语言。取值：
zh-CN：中文
en-US：英文

默认值：en-US
parameters.name: accept_language

RDSRegion.description_en: The list of available regions and zones
RDSRegion.description_zh: 可选的地域和可用区列表

items.description_en: The details of a region and zone

LocalName.description_en:
The region name. The language of the returned value varies based on the value of the AcceptLanguage parameter. The following examples show the returned values for the cn-hangzhou region:
If AcceptLanguage is set to zh-CN: 华东1（杭州）
If AcceptLanguage is set to en-US: China (Hangzhou)
LocalName.description_zh:
地域名称。根据AcceptLanguage参数的值返回不同的语言。以cn-hangzhou地域为例的返回示例如下：
AcceptLanguage为zh-CN：华东1（杭州）
AcceptLanguage为en-US：China (Hangzhou)

RegionEndpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the region. For more information, see [Service registration]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610370.html）
RegionEndpoint.description_zh: 地域对应的服务接入地址（Endpoint）。更多信息，请参见[服务接入点]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610370.html）

ZoneName.description_en:
The zone name. The language of the returned value varies based on the value of the AcceptLanguage parameter. The following examples show the returned values for the cn-hangzhou-j zone:
If AcceptLanguage is set to zh-CN: 杭州 可用区J
If AcceptLanguage is set to en-US: Hangzhou Zone J
ZoneName.description_zh:
可用区名称。根据AcceptLanguage参数的值返回不同的语言。以cn-hangzhou-j可用区为例的返回示例如下：
AcceptLanguage为zh-CN：杭州 可用区J
AcceptLanguage为en-US：Hangzhou Zone J
